summary: Executed backend+frontend regression for admin approvals, RBAC, unified buyer surfaces, and key UI workflows. Backend critical paths passed; frontend exposed a reproducible CMS buyer-directory timeout/integration issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Directory table remains empty and eventually shows timeout banner ('timeout of 30000ms exceeded') while parent header already shows large total records.

integration_issues.issue: Public and admin APIs return buyer data, but BuyerDirectory request times out in-browser; table shows 0 buyers and Add User/Hard Delete row actions are unreachable.

issues: Cookie consent banner overlaps lower account content, reducing immediate viewport usability.

action_items: Fix BuyerDirectory timeout path so list rows load reliably (same data source as parent BuyersManager count).
Optimize /api/buyers/admin/list for pagination requests (current implementation has per-row enrichment loop likely causing latency spikes).
After fix, retest Add User modal and Hard Delete confirmation flow against populated rows.
Run targeted retest for RegistryMatchNotice with a user that has an active registry candidate/accepted match (current tested account did not render this notice).
critical_code_review_comments: vbie_admin.admin_list performs N+1 queries per buyer row (members_bridge + registry_matches + _user_doc + profiles per uid), which is a likely root cause for intermittent 30s UI timeouts under browser load.
Buyer list data is fetched in both BuyersManager and BuyerDirectory, increasing duplicate load and amplifying timeout probability.
Runtime warning seen in backend logs: JWT HMAC secret length is 31 bytes (below recommended 32 for HS256).
seed_data_creation: Created one test Command Center project ('TEST Iter57 Project') under existing subscriber test account for UI module validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend approval/RBAC smoke passed and public/admin buyer APIs are healthy via pytest and curl. Main unresolved issue is frontend BuyerDirectory timeout despite API availability; verify in-browser network timings for /api/buyers/admin/list and compare parent vs child consumers.
rca of the issue: Repro: login main admin -> Admin CMS -> Verified Buyers tab -> wait ~30s. Observed: header shows ~24k records, but directory count stays 0 then error banner 'timeout of 30000ms exceeded'. Backend endpoint works via curl (200 with rows, ~13s using X-Admin-Token), so issue is likely compounded by frontend duplicate list calls + expensive backend row enrichment (N+1) causing sporadic >30s in browser context.
